# Upstream

> Is the AI or developer API your agent depends on up right now, and what's changing? Upstream watches ~40 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, Mistral, Groq, GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, Twilio...) every few minutes, and tracks model deprecation, retirement and pricing pages for the major LLM providers.

## Free tier (most agents never pay)
- 500 calls/day with a free key. Get one instantly: POST https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/keys, then send header X-API-Key.
- 50 calls/day with no key at all.
- 1 free change-alert webhook per key.
- Every response carries X-Free-Remaining.

## Over the free quota: x402 pay-per-call (USDC)
Network: eip155:84532 (currently Base Sepolia testnet). Unpaid calls over quota get HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2); retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
- Always-paid lane (no quota, same data): /x402/status/{provider}, /x402/changes, /x402/model/{id}
- GET /status/:provider: $0.003
- GET /changes: $0.01
- GET /model/:id: $0.003
- POST /v1/watches (each extra webhook watch, 30 days): $0.05

## Endpoints
- GET https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/providers (always free): list of providers and current state
- GET https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/status/{provider}: state (operational | degraded | partial_outage | major_outage | maintenance | unknown), incidents, affected components, safe_to_call
- GET https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/changes?since=ISO&provider=&kind=status|deprecations|model_retirement|pricing: change feed
- GET https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/model/{id}: active | deprecated | retired | unknown, with shutdown date, replacement and the exact table row it came from
- POST https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/v1/watches {"provider","url"}: signed webhooks (X-Upstream-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, body))
- POST https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/mcp: MCP (streamable HTTP) with tools list_providers, get_status, get_changes, get_model. Over quota, a tool returns the x402 requirement; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].
- OpenAPI: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/openapi.json

## Daily breaking-changes digest (free)
- Page + archive: https://upstream-api.pages.dev/digest/
- JSON: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest/latest and https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest/{YYYY-MM-DD}; list: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest
- Atom feed: https://upstream.toolweather.workers.dev/digest/feed.xml
- MCP tool: get_digest {date?}
- Published daily at 12:00 UTC; combines Upstream (AI/dev API incidents, model deprecations/retirements, pricing-page changes) with Toolweather (breaking MCP tool changes, servers down/back, broken OAuth logins).

## Legal
- Terms of Service: https://upstream-api.pages.dev/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://upstream-api.pages.dev/privacy
- Contact: toolweather@mail.grokbot.com (operator: Toolweather, Mexico)

## Notes
- Data comes from official public status pages and docs. "unknown" means our check failed, not that the provider is down.
- Responses include a "sponsored" field, reserved and always null for now. No ads.
